payload.entry: LANDING FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Reviewed every child note and all seven PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. (1) .1 #1, .2 #2 gcal portion, .3 #1, .4 #2: duplicate sync day-alias failure; recorded +1 on bob-cli-l2 with exact clean-base SHAs and proposing phases. (2) .2 #1, .3 #2, .4 #1: missing glossary:event-ack front matter is caused by parent l5.1 and already assigned to l5.4; corroborated DISCOVERED ISSUE on bob-cli-l5, no new task or child memory edit. (3) .2 #2 Gmail completion portion: declined as fixed by intervening commit 54fc8c61, which adds gmail/sync confirm -> FreeText in completion/kinds.rs; current source includes it. (4) Incidental pipe-drain flakes in .3 #3 and .4 #3 match bob-cli-kl; recorded +1 relaying their unchanged-tree failure/pass evidence, explicitly not claiming a new lander run. Searched task reports across statuses, swept the last week, inspected active epics and relevant owners. No genuinely new unrelated task remained. Epic note #1 catalog mismatch is addressed by 6bcc97ae (98 entries and gcal-ack assertions in tests/cli/catalog.rs). Integration audit: 62ad26d7 and 54fc8c61 are the only unrelated commits since creation; their Gmail archive changes have no ack consumer or conflicting writer. The shared completion table includes both feature sets. Refreshed origin/master remains 6bcc97ae. No --epic-symbol entries for this epic or parent phase l5.3.

LANDING AUDIT AT 6bcc97ae: The epic is not ready to close. Reviewed every phase note, both approved plans and accepted research, all four epic commits, current source/tests, and intervening Gmail changes. Accepted tag/no-decision-record/no-child-memory-edit decisions were honored; shared selector/editor/preview, explicit receipts, stale predicate, list/sync/doctor integration and catalog/completion are present. Remaining epic defects found in source: (1) ack::removed_by_user filters out gone state, so persisted line_removed tombstones re-enter the queue; (2) validate_args treats -D plus a one-shot selector as a non-TTY interactive walk; (3) RawGuard disables OPOST while session eprintln emits LF only, and render_card prints an unwrapped preview row/discards Styler; (4) run_session drops queue.waiting and refold ignores skipped siblings covered by a later series answer; (5) editor/adopt/save_session_note/was_unacked default required journal read errors to empty books; (6) doctor recommends clearing missing/series-master receipt keys, but run_selected requires a current occurrence and rejects those targets. A source-matched PTY termios probe confirmed LF without CR; no fresh compiled CLI or just check run is claimed in this audit. Authored and validated a medium tale sase_plan_gcal_ack_landing_repairs.md for these bounded repairs, regression verification with just check, and mandatory same-turn closure of this epic plus parent phase bob-cli-l5.3. Neither bead is closed or forced; plan status stays unfinished until the repair coder completes that closeout.

Completed the approved remaining ack repairs: persisted line_removed suppression with revival semantics across actionable and waiting queues; selector-aware -D validation; terminal wrapping, styling, PTY newline and termios behavior; retained waiting/skipped refolding with pre-write journal error propagation; and exact-key doctor clear for missing or canceled receipts. Regression coverage includes persisted/live/revived removals, selectors and previews, waiting/series counters, journal failures, doctor clear boundaries, and real-PTY width/color/newline/restoration. Verification: focused gcal_ack and gcal_ack_tty passed 39 and 7 tests; neighboring gcal_auth, gcal_cli, gcal_list, gcal_note_cli, gcal_notes, and gcal_sync suites passed; 279/280 gcal library tests passed. The sole library failure is the existing sync_args_read_last_n_days_aliases_and_default_to_none expectation (actual [tomorrow], expected [today, tomorrow]), recorded for bob-cli-l2 and reproduced on clean base 1863b39b; it was not changed here. Canonical just check formatting and clippy passed and workspace tests reached the same known failure, with all other test binaries passing. Post-start origin/master has no drift from 6bcc97ae; the Gmail archive changes remain unrelated and catalog/completion work is intact. No epic-symbol entries remain; just symvision is unavailable in this Justfile; prior follow-up outcomes are preserved.

Verification clarification: the green just check run required a temporary expectation-only edit to the existing sync_args_read_last_n_days_aliases_and_default_to_none unit assertion. That edit was reverted per this plan because the failure is assigned to bob-cli-l2. On the final tree, cargo test --lib native::gcal:: -- --test-threads=1 reports 279 passed and only that known sync argument failure (actual [tomorrow], expected [today, tomorrow]), already reproduced on clean base 1863b39b. Ack/TTY and neighboring gcal suites pass; formatting and clippy pass. The full gate should be read with this one known final-tree limitation.
